changes: In /agent/solver.md I added a hard rule at the top: do not call submit until a brute-force vs fast random cross-check shows zero mismatches and a max-size timing check has been run. I also added a mandatory pre-submit gate to step 7, telling the agent to iterate rather than stop early since most runs use only about 4 of 16 calls, and to re-read the statement for special cases (for example, a forbidden starting state) before writing the brute force. The failure analysis showed most misses were submits right after the public examples passed (5 wrong answers on hidden tests, 4 slow or failing programs). One trial on lcb-3655 still failed: the agent submitted again without the cross-check, so the rule has not yet changed behaviour. I did not run a second trial.
